ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: All delivered petitions are ordinary official 072A, selected from their actual facts. No early, guilty, pardon or cannabis-conviction vehicle is substituted. Broader registry options remain an A/Chat6 selector reconciliation, not approval by this review.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Held one-page 09/2025 072A freshly hashed; current official issuer page and complete source face examined. Held raw digest is measured; live issuer raw digest is not. Current recovery registry blob 5924798ceb808e8013ebb74838469ea9b39238d8 still matches the declared contract anchor.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Each four-page packet actually delivers one official petition plus three separately identified participant-instruction pages. Ordinary free filing calls for no fee waiver, attached release, participant service certificate or proposed order. Declared component selections match actual pages.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: 268 held-text writes were read back within their actual mapped rectangles, including repeated name/contact/date fields and long accented boundary text. Facts, maps and actual pages were compared; no known field was found silently omitted.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The boundary agency is genuinely null, blank on the petition and specifically disclosed on instruction pages 2 and 3. Signature/date completion is expressly required. Unknown predicate and missing-discharge probes leave the disposition unmarkable. This is not proof that runtime has collected every fact.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: All supplied selections and clocks are correct, and all 46 declared marks have ink. Mixed basis/date, pending case, future discharge, protected signature, early-release and wrong-instrument probes behave correctly. CHAT4-MD-01 independently demonstrates contradictory PBJ entry/discharge dates can still authorize a mark.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The fifteen supplied one-incident charge lists and disposition dates are coherent. Verbatim predicate probes reject mixed dispositions and mixed dates rather than collapse them. No complete multi-charge overflow PDF is claimed reviewed; non-fitting or unlike units remain outside this bounded candidate coverage.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Eleven protected source regions per packet, 165 total, are pixel-identical to the held source. Participant signature/date and attorney execution are blank. Printed defendant identifying fields remain filled. No notarial or judicial execution is invented.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Actual ZIP, all fifteen whole PDFs, source, map/instructions, all52 publication-manifest files and all60 retained page entries were hashed. Whole-output and PNG identities are separate in md-measurements.json. This is retained-candidate proof, not installed GitHub/runtime or central-raster admission.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: All15 actual four-page outputs have official petition first, then before-filing, finish/file/follow-up and source/contents instructions. No missing, duplicated or substituted component page found.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All60 complete page instances visually examined. Boundary accent, long address, incident continuation, source recitals and source execution blocks remain readable. In-rectangle text checks corroborate placement. No observed visual defect in supplied PDFs.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: District and adult-transferee circuit variants use their actual selected court and address. Guide distinguishes original court, receiving adult court, original juvenile-transfer court and appellate help. Rockville district and circuit addresses checked against official directories. Juvenile transfer requests criminal records, not juvenile records.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Current Judiciary 072A instructions support no filing fee. Packets do not import the guilty-disposition fee, a prepaid-cost waiver or a tort release. Tort-claim release is distinguished from fee waiver and directed to the separate treatment.

SERVICE.finding: Court service on the State's Attorney, 30-day objection clock after service, hearing after timely objection and custodian follow-up are correctly explained. No false participant certificate is delivered.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Actual instructions stop for objection/hearing, disputed unit, excluded PBJ, appeal or release decision and provide practical help/record retention. No promise of relief or complete third-party deletion is made.

nineCounters.scope: Zeros describe only the supplied complete candidate pages and their actual maps. No exhaustive production blank-disposition or runtime intake census was executed. The boundary deliberately has one disclosed unknown agency; signature/date completion remains participant work. CHAT4-MD-01 is not hidden by these fixture-only counters.
